defects.title: Page title is generic default "frontend"
defects.description: The browser page title in index.html is literally "frontend" instead of "JobFit Resume — ATS Resume Builder". The assertion pageTitle.length > 0 was a weak assertion that masked this.
defects.reproduction: Open http://localhost:3000 and observe browser tab title.

defects.title: Candidate experience heuristic uses arbitrary (roles * 2) instead of date calculation
defects.description: JobMatchingService.calculateCandidateExperienceYears() computes candidate years as totalRoles * 2. It ignores actual start and end dates. A single 10-year job counts as 2 years; two 2-month summer internships count as 4 years.

defects.title: PDF Template "classic": Dates and metadata float to the top of the text stream
defects.description: In OpenHTMLtoPDF rendering, CSS float: right or flex emulation causes dates ("Present", "2016-2020") or tech tags to be emitted in the PDF text stream before the candidate name and header. First 5 lines: "2016 – 2020 Java 21, Spring Boot 3, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Docker 2021-03 – Present Alex Rivera Audit Lead Full Stack Architect | Java 21 & React"
defects.reproduction: Export PDF for template "classic" and extract text using PDF reader/parser.

warnings.title: Template switch test has false-positive prone assertion
warnings.description: P5-02 asserts true immediately after clicking the template button without asserting that the preview DOM re-rendered with the new template layout or CSS classes.

warnings.title: Document export tests only validated file size and magic bytes
warnings.description: P5-03 and P5-04 only verified that the download occurred and file size was > 2000 bytes. They did not parse document text, verify section presence, check layout clipping, or test all 3 templates.
